description: This file declares functions and macros for a specialized CUDA/ROCm implementation of multi-head attention mechanisms in PyTorch, focusing on transformer architectures. It includes API declarations for forward and backward passes with support for variable sequence lengths, causal masking, and different backend implementations (CUDA, ROCm).

methods.name: mha_fwd_aot
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of multi-head attention using AOT (Ahead-Of-Time) kernel.

methods.name: mha_varlen_fwd_aot
methods.description: Performs variable-length sequence attention forward with AOT kernel.

methods.name: mha_bwd_aot
methods.description: Performs the backward pass of attention with AOT kernel.

methods.name: mha_fwd
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of multi-head attention, automatically choosing the implementation based on backend.
